text:
marta: Quick heads-up — onboarding pipeline: some EU tenants are stuck in 'finalizing' during provisioning. Seen ~42 tenants since 03:10 UTC. Customers who hit it see stalled progress + no portal access. Triaging with infra now, need a short customer-facing update ready in 15m.

raj: FYI root-cause sketch: yesterday's bulk CSV import triggered many SSO callbacks; backplane sync queue spiked, KV cache eviction caused a retry storm and worker saturation. Not a customer data loss issue, but provisioning tasks timed out.

ben: Confirmed. Workers exhausted file descriptors and started returning 503 to the provisioner. We're increasing worker pool, bumping ulimits, and enabling a circuit-breaker for callback retries. Will post mitigation ETA shortly.

lee: Draft for customers (short + action + ETA):
```
We're investigating an issue affecting tenant provisioning for some EU customers. Impact: final step of onboarding may show 'finalizing' indefinitely and portal access could be delayed. Mitigation: we are scaling the provisioning workers and running manual retries; most affected tenants are restoring access within 10-25 minutes. We're posting status updates at https://status.redwood.example. If you're impacted, reply to this thread and we'll prioritize your tenant.
```

marta: +1 to that draft. Add an explicit apology and offer a 30-min office hours slot for high-touch customers. Also include a direct contact for urgent cases.

raj: RCA customer-facing bullets (non-technical):
- What happened: surge of callbacks caused a processing backlog in our onboarding pipeline.
- Impact: provisioning delays for a subset of EU tenants (no data loss).
- Mitigation we did: scaled workers, raised process limits, applied retry backoff, manually retried stuck jobs.
- Next steps: adding rate-limits to callback ingestion and improving early backpressure signals to prevent recurrence.

ben: Live mitigation status:
- +30 workers added to EU pool (03:28 UTC)
- ulimit increased on nodes (03:34 UTC)
- Circuit breaker + exponential backoff deployed (03:45 UTC)
- Manual requeue started (03:50 UTC) — ~38/42 tenants retried, 34 succeeded so far, 4 still in progress.

lee: Customer outreach plan: send the draft message to impacted contacts now, then follow-up once all tenants restored with a short RCA and credit offer if they're in renewal window. For top 5 high-touch accounts, ping AMs + offer dedicated troubleshooting slot.

marta: Posted initial customer note to affected list at 04:05 UTC. Copy of the sent message:
```
Hello — we rolled out a short update about provisioning delays impacting EU onboarding. We've scaled systems and are manually rerunning stuck jobs; most tenants are restored. We sincerely apologize for the disruption. We'll send a follow-up with an RCA and next steps within 24 hours. For urgent help, contact cs+priority@redwood.example or join office hours at https://meet.redwood.example/office-hours.
```

raj: I'll draft the 24-hour RCA doc with timeline + remediation plan. Will include logs/metrics and the planned configuration changes for the backplane (rate-limits, queue sizing, alert thresholds).

ben: Ops notes for postmortem: add perf test for callback bursts, raise node FD alert earlier, add canary for retry storms.

lee: Follow-up outreach checklist sent to CS ops playbook. We'll offer affected customers one month of waived Dedicated buffer charges if renewal risk flagged.

incident-bot: Bridge closed at 04:40 UTC — incident moved to postmortem.

marta: Thanks team. Next steps: raj to share RCA draft by 03/22 03:00 UTC, ben to open infra PRs for ulimit & backpressure, lee to run outreach and log responses. I'll coordinate exec summary for impacted renewal segments. :pray:
